tasks.title: Announcement #52
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a school event.
tasks.transcript: Woman: I have an exciting opportunity for all fashion design majors. We'll be working with an up and coming business downtown that focuses solely on young adult clothing. If you're in your second year or higher, you can apply for an internship with them with the possibility of being hired once you graduate. They're also accepting design submissions for their company logo, and the creator of the selected design will be paid for it. Their website has all the details. I'll give you that URL now.

questions.stem: What can we infer about the business mentioned by the speaker?

options.A: It has been open for many years.
options.B: It was started by a fashion design student at the university.
options.D: It is moving to a new location.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：关于演讲者提到的那家公司，我们可以推断出什么？ 定位原文：Woman: We'll be working with an up and coming business downtown that focuses solely on young adult clothing. 选项分析： A. It has been open for many years. 它已经开业很多年了。因为演讲者称其为“新兴的”公司，且专注于年轻人服装，暗示其比较年轻，而非经营多年，所以A选项错误。 B. It was started by a fashion design student at the university. 它是由该校的一名时装设计学生创办的。因为对话中只提到该公司与学校合作，并未提及创办者的身份，所以B选项错误。 C. It targets a narrow market. 它针对的是一个细分市场。由于该公司“只专注于”年轻人服装，相比于全年龄段服装，这属于一个特定的细分市场，所以C选项正确。 D. It is moving to a new location. 它正在搬迁到新地点。因为对话中未提及搬迁信息，只说了它在市中心，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why should listeners visit the website?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：听众为什么要访问该网站？ 定位原文：Woman: They're also accepting design submissions for their company logo, and the creator of the selected design will be paid for it. Their website has all the details. 选项分析： A. To purchase young adult clothing 购买年轻人服装。因为这是针对学生的实习和设计征集通知，而不是购物广告，所以A选项错误。 B. To view a new logo 查看新标志。因为网站是为了征集新标志的设计方案，而不是展示已经完成的标志，所以B选项错误。 C. To learn about a contest 了解一场比赛。由于网站上有提交设计以获得报酬的详细信息，这属于一种设计竞赛或征集活动，所以C选项正确。 D. To provide some feedback 提供一些反馈。因为通知的目的是招募实习和征集设计，而不是收集反馈意见，所以D选项错误
